where.instructions: Where do the words point: at something on this page, at something on youtube.com that is not on this page, or somewhere else on the web?

options.page: on this page: one of the numbered refs
options.site: on youtube.com but not on this page: a page, a person, a post, a section of it
options.web: elsewhere: another website, or a search of the whole web

outcome.instructions: Is what the user asked for done? First: if a pop-up, sign-in prompt or challenge covers the page now, choose in_the_way; a cookie strip or other notice on the page that covers nothing is not in the way. Otherwise judge by their words and Done so far, not by the page alone: choose yes when the page shows what they asked to see, or the action they asked for has happened; not_yet when more steps are needed.

options.yes: done: the page shows it, or the action they asked for has happened
options.in_the_way: a pop-up or prompt covers the page now
options.not_yet: not done: more to do, nothing covering the page

progress.instructions: Did the last action in Done so far bring the page closer to what the user's words ask for? Judge by what it did and the page now: closer when it did part or all of what they asked, or opened the way to it; not closer when what changed is not what they asked for.

passage.instructions: Which block of Text in view states what the user asked to know, in the page's own words? Choose none when no block states it, or when the user asked for an action and nothing to be told.
